property_summary: Only the depositor address can change the timestamp stored in c (calls from other senders must not be able to modify number/timestamp), so when a non-depositor calls setL1BlockValues the observed timestamp remains equal to the prior value.
change_summary: Relax the onlyDepositor check to allow any caller (remove require), so timestamp can be set by others — changes which calls succeed and thus observable timestamp differences for different callers.
